title.narrative: Extension of FDI

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the proposed action is to support global advocacy, multilateral partnership, policy development and implementation of integrated approaches to address the challenges of disaster displacement.


The specific objectives are:

1.    Provide the PDD Chair and Steering Group with policy, research, administrative, communication and other types of technical assistance and support.

2.     Support UN member states in their efforts to enhance policy coherence and integrated implementation of global policy frameworks on human mobility, climate change action and disaster risk reduction.

3.     Promote policy and normative development to address gaps in the protection of persons at risk of disaster displacement and displaced within their own countries or across borders.

4.     Facilitate exchange of knowledge and strengthen capacity at the national and regional levels to implement effective practices and policy instruments that can avert, minimize and address disaster displacement.

5.     Promote coordinated efforts to strengthen evidence and data on disaster displacement and its impacts.
